In [[3643 BBY]], [[Exo-technology|exo-technologist]] [[Tharan Cedrax]] developed a '''weapon prototype''' while on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He tried to sell it to a group of [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], but rescinded the deal when he learned that the Nikto were part of the [[Guiding Hand]] gang, which was performing raids against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] holdings, as Cedrax was afraid of the Hutts' revenge. Cedrax later gave the weapon to the [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] who tried to infiltrate the Guiding Hand. The Jedi used the weapon to prove their expertise to the [[Red Light Lancers]] tech gang, a part of the Guiding Hand.
